- Requirement: "Create prompts/references/security-money-lens.txt as the single source of truth for money-handling security" and requirement 7: "Use the renderer's existing generic REFERENCE_* hydration; do not introduce a competing reference mechanism."
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-plan.txt, prompts/_templates/mode-plan.txt, prompts/mode-implement.txt, prompts/_templates/mode-implement.txt should contain `{{REFERENCE_SECURITY_MONEY_LENS}}` placeholders that the renderer hydrates from prompts/references/security-money-lens.txt, matching the existing pattern used by `{{REFERENCE_OUTPUT_CONTRACT}}` and `{{REFERENCE_VERIFICATION_LOOP}}`.
  Evidence of absence: All four prompt bodies inline the seven money-handling bullet points verbatim instead of using the `{{REFERENCE_SECURITY_MONEY_LENS}}` placeholder. The test `test_security_money_lens_renders_in_plan_and_implement_prompts` confirms this: it calls `_run_render_prompt_py(prompt_path)` without passing `REFERENCE_SECURITY_MONEY_LENS` as a variable and still asserts the reference text appears in stdout. The reference file exists and the contracts declare the optional var, but no prompt body consumes the placeholder, so the reference file is orphaned and the text is duplicated five times (reference file + four prompt bodies). Future edits to the reference file will not propagate to the prompts.
